description: PWM-conditioned (VimarsaBridgeV2) vs bare-LLM on camatkāra heuristic

phase5_gate_reference.note: Phase 5 ratio was computed in dry-run mode with simulated scores. Live ablation is the first real measurement.

live_result.claim: PWM-conditioned generation > bare LLM on camatk_text score

english_pop.verdict: LLM > PWM on English pop domain

carnatic.verdict: LLM >> PWM on carnatic domain (120B excels at English-script Carnatic)

kannada_film.verdict: Near-parity; slight LLM advantage on Kannada film lyrics

scientific_interpretation.result: NEGATIVE — H5 does not hold under text-only camatkāra scoring with 120B LLM baseline
scientific_interpretation.confidence: BCa 95% CI [-0.12, -0.02] excludes zero; result is robust
scientific_interpretation.key_finding: The 120B LLM (nemotron-3-super) produces higher text-level camatkāra scores without WM conditioning than with it
scientific_interpretation.methodological_note: Phase 5 ratio=2.14 was a dry-run simulation. The live ablation is the first real measurement. The text-only scorer cannot include VFE (WM-aware) terms, making this a fair but partial comparison.
scientific_interpretation.interpretation: The WM conditioning does not improve text-level quality when the LLM is sufficiently powerful. This is consistent with the theoretical frame: the WM's contribution is in the creative PROCESS (sphurattā events, vimarśa state, long-horizon planning) not in improving text-surface quality over an unconditioned 120B baseline. The LLM is already near-ceiling on the text-only scorer for English domains (0.93-1.0). The Kannada film domain shows near-parity, suggesting WM conditioning may be more valuable for lower-resource domains.
scientific_interpretation.per_claude_md_section7: Reported as negative result with full statistical rigour (paired permutation 50K perms, Hedges' g, BCa 95% CI). Negative results reported with same rigour as positives.

gate_interpretation: FAIL on text-only scorer. The WM's value is in internal representational quality (VFE, sphurattā, Hopfield) not text-surface improvement over 120B LLM.
